details: §5.12 contains 3 acceptance points in the spec: (1) layout uniformity, (2) silent oversize failure, (3) error surfacing for ANY upload failure.
BA decomposed these into R1 (layout), R2 (oversize client block), R3 (send-time error block). All three map 1:1 to spec acceptance points with verbatim source_phrase.

MoSCoW splits into Cluster A (layout: A1-A4) and Cluster B (error surfacing: B1-B3) — matching the two-bug structure. S1-S2 enhance error surfacing. C1 is optional inline error detail. Won't-Have explicitly excludes server changes, MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES modification, retry, animations.

The 3rd acceptance point of spec §5.12.3 ('error for ANY reason: size, network, MIME') is correctly covered by B2 (send-time guard for any status==='error' regardless of cause) plus S1 (use server's authoritative error text when available).
No scope creep: all files_to_modify in context JSON directly map to MoSCoW items. The 9 translation files are properly scoped to B3.

trace_steps_verified: Client pickImage/pickDocument/addFileFromPaste → client-side size check (silent return on fail)
Client uploadFile → sync.uploadAttachment → HTTP POST to server
Server v3SessionRoutes.ts:267-269 → 413 with { error: 'File too large (max 10 MB)' }
Client uploadFile catch block (lines 157-159) → sets attachment.status='error' with error message
AttachmentStrip renders error icon overlay (lines 45-49) when status==='error'
useComposerSend line 441 filters readyAttachments to status==='ready' (excludes error items from payload)
useComposerSend line 444 clearAttachments() wipes ALL items — including error-state — with no user notification

root_cause_identification.layout_bug: Correctly attributed to commit f6f129a1 (2026-03-25 auto-commit) which changed overlay.left from 0 to 4 and strip padding from split horizontal/vertical to uniform `padding: 12`.
root_cause_identification.silent_failure_bug: Correctly identified as three distinct silent-return callsites (deliberate day-1 shortcut in f8b208fa) PLUS the clearAttachments-drops-error-chips behavior in useComposerSend.

investigation.architecture_awareness: BA correctly flagged that useAttachments hook should NOT import Modal directly (violates hooks-don't-import-UI-layer convention) and proposed two valid alternatives: HappyError throw (handled by useHappyAction wrapper) or onAttachmentRejected callback exposed by the hook. This preserves layer separation.

objections.claim: BA says line 444 `clearAttachments() silently removes all items including error-state ones — silent discard`
objections.observation: Strictly speaking, line 441 already filters readyAttachments to status==='ready', so error-state attachments are NEVER included in the message payload to begin with. The user-visible bug is that (a) the message LOOKS sent because clearAttachments wipes the UI, (b) the user doesn't realize some files failed. BA captures this correctly overall, but the phrasing 'silently removes failed items' could be read as 'sends error chips too' which is not the case. Dev should understand: the message goes out successfully with only ready chips; error chips are just wiped silently.
objections.impact: Low — BA's proposed fix (B2: check for any status==='error' before send, block and alert) still addresses the real bug. Nuance doesn't change the fix shape.

objections.claim: BA A3 offers two equivalent layout approaches (chip.width = THUMB_SIZE+8 with alignItems center, OR chip.width = THUMB_SIZE with marginRight gutter)
objections.observation: Both produce pixel-identical layouts visually. Dev should pick ONE consistently; don't mix. BA explicitly states 'The chosen approach must be identical for preview and fileIcon' so this is covered.

objections.claim: BA says add translations to 9 language files (en, zh-Hans, zh-Hant, ru, pl, es, ca, it, pt, ja)
objections.observation: happy-app CLAUDE.md confirms this exact list of supported languages. BA is accurate.

dev_guidance: BA's MoSCoW Must-Have items (A1-A4, B1-B3) are sufficient to satisfy all 3 spec acceptance points.
Use BA's HappyError throw pattern OR callback pattern for Modal integration — do NOT import Modal into useAttachments.ts.
For B2 (send-time guard), the cleanest implementation: add `hasErrorAttachments` to useAttachments return value, check it in useComposerSend BEFORE the msg.trim() guard.
Both desktop (1280x720) AND mobile (390x844) viewports must be verified — mandatory per project policy.
Error text per Contract C: 'File exceeds 10 MB limit.' Do not invent new size constants.
